clean_room_contracts_extracted.context_definition_CORTI_VERBATIM: A Context (identified by a server-generated contextId) is a logical grouping of related Messages, Tasks, and Artifacts, providing context across a multi-turn 'conversation'. It enables you to associate multiple tasks and agents with a single patient encounter, call, or workflow, ensuring continuity and proper scoping of shared knowledge throughout.

context_properties.contextId_generation: SERVER-GENERATED ONLY. Client must never generate contextId.
context_properties.reason_corti_verbatim: ensures proper state management and prevents conflicts
context_properties.data_isolation: STRICT — data can NEVER leak across contexts
context_properties.sharing_mechanism: explicit DataPart in messages (no auto cross-context sharing)

automatic_memory_workflow: First message: send WITHOUT contextId → server creates new context
Subsequent messages: include contextId → memory from prior messages in that context is automatically managed and available
clean_room_contracts_extracted.standalone_request_mode: omit contextId → each message is standalone, no prior history access (use case: one-off queries / testing / explicit control)

purpose: structured data (patient records, clinical facts) alongside text
summaries or distilled information from external sources
metadata or configuration for this specific request
combine automatic memory (contextId) with explicit context (DataPart)

auto_indexing_scope: any other content flowing through the context
semantic_retrieval_flow: semantic search across all indexed content in context memory
retrieves most semantically relevant information based on current query
memory_architecture.icoder_implication: Corti public memory is RAG/semantic. iCoDer Charter §13.1 specifies LEXICAL_ONLY baseline. iCoDer is therefore STRICTLY WEAKER than Corti public memory until embedding tier is added. Must NOT mark semantic parity. MEMORY_RUNTIME=LEXICAL_ONLY until embedding Provider egress is wired.

context_vs_referenceTaskIds.referenceTaskIds_role: optional list of specific past Task IDs within same context; explicit input/background hint
context_vs_referenceTaskIds.scoping: referenceTaskIds are scoped to a context (cannot reference tasks in other contexts)
context_vs_referenceTaskIds.use_guidance: ignore referenceTaskIds unless explicit prioritization needed in complex multi-step workflows

context_vs_interactionId.corti_position: NOT LINKED — contextId (Agentic Framework) and interactionId (Corti internal) are separate concepts
context_vs_interactionId.developer responsibility: maintain own mapping in application state
context_vs_interactionId.recommended_pattern: one fresh context per interaction; store interactionId↔contextId mapping in app metadata

icoder_mapping_notes.context_model: matches iCoDer PreviewSession / RunHistory / run_id (Phase 7) + Context model to be added in A1B-AE.5
icoder_mapping_notes.datapart: must be added to iCoDer message envelope; currently iCoDer messages are text-only in some paths
icoder_mapping_notes.server_generated_contextId: iCoDer already does this for PreviewSession (Phase 7 Gate 13A) — pattern to be reused
